name: command
description: A source-owned Dioxus filterable command palette backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied facade wires query-filtering, roving focus, and per-item on_select callbacks from adico-primitives::command; CommandDialog composes the installed dialog registry item directly for the 'command dialog' launcher pattern rather than reimplementing focus-trapping/Escape/outside-dismissal.
documentation.accessibility: CommandInput is a text input with aria-autocomplete="list"/aria-controls/aria-activedescendant pointing at the roving-focus-highlighted CommandItem; CommandList is role="listbox", each CommandItem is role="option" (packages/adico-primitives/src/command.rs).
documentation.keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the roving highlight across visible (unfiltered-out) items; Enter activates the highlighted item's own on_select. Note: CommandEmpty's visible/hidden state is populated by each item's own mount effect, so on non-hydrated server-rendered output specifically it can show even when items match, self-correcting once the client hydrates (packages/adico-primitives/src/command.rs's own doc comment).
